steps.what: Verify protocol windows and subjects' procedure, resource and availability requirements
Find appointment, procedure or inpatient slot options within verified constraints
Schedule the agreed appointment and confirm subject and clinical service arrangements

tasks.design: Configure {CALENDAR} to find options from a coordinator-verified protocol booking brief. Keep clinical constraints, subject agreement and service confirmation human through {TELEPHONY}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Slot comparison can be repeated across several resources and protocol windows.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource calendars can calculate options from explicit constraints.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve clinical dependencies and confirm inpatient or procedure capacity.
tasks.human_edge: Understand when a technically available slot is inappropriate for the subject.
tasks.altitude: Less slot searching, unchanged booking and clinical authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit calendar constraint matching can support protocol scheduling; this does not establish clinical appropriateness or local productivity gains.

assumptions: Boundary is coordinator scheduling, excluding eligibility assessment, clinical ordering and service delivery.

The coordinator produces subject reference, protocol revision, reference event date, permitted window, duration, required staff/equipment/bed, time zone and subject availability in s1. Clinicians supply existing procedure instructions before this capture; manual elicitation and verification retain the full 40%. Missing clinical constraints return to the responsible clinician.

Subjects and service staff produce their choice and capacity confirmation after options exist and before booking in s3; coordinator capture and clarification are retained in its full 35%. No free ready-to-book or available-bed flag is assumed.
Test native calendar configuration first. Where calendars lack reliable inpatient capacity, options and confirmation remain manual rather than inventing an integration.
unknowns: Calendar resource coverage and inpatient confirmation process
research_questions: Is there enough reliable resource data to reduce slot searching after clinical checks?

already_counted.description: Subject agreement, service confirmation and booking approval

incremental.description: Protocol window and resource mapping upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact subject, procedure or stay, protocol window, chosen slot, clinical instructions and service confirmation checked before booking; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+35=75; gross=25, incremental=7, net=18. Range 0-7 allows missing bed capacity or an existing scheduling tool to erase much of the slot-search gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Perform protocol procedures including interviewing, vital signs and electrocardiograms within qualifications

tasks.design: Keep interviews and physical measurements with qualified staff using {OTHER} clinical measurement equipment and the protocol in {DOCS}. Existing instrument runtime is retained as equipment operation, with no human labour saving claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedures require subject interaction, physical setup and recognition of abnormal conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No new procedure automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Obtain reliable measurements and respond within delegated clinical limits.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise subject distress and an unreliable or abnormal measurement.
tasks.altitude: Procedure duties and clinical authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: interviews and physical clinical measurements retain human preparation, interaction and observation in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is delegated procedure execution, excluding clinician diagnosis and subsequent treatment. {OTHER} means clinical measurement equipment.

The investigator supplies protocol and delegation before execution; the coordinator verifies subject identity, current consent, permitted procedure and equipment setup within s1. Measurements and responses arise during execution before review; capture and escalation stay within retained time. No free cleared-for-procedure flag is assumed.
Uncertain consent, delegation or clinical conditions stop the procedure and return to the responsible clinician.
Test native equipment recording before custom tools; none is added. Incremental upkeep is zero because existing equipment and duties remain unchanged.
research_questions: Is any duplicate transcription separate from the physical procedure and measurement review?

already_counted.description: Procedure checks, subject interaction, capture and escalation

approvals.approved_version: Exact subject, current consent, protocol procedure, delegation, equipment setup and present condition verified before each procedure; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0; net=0. Routine measurements and subject concerns retain physical procedure and interaction time; existing instrument runtime earns no savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess eligibility through screening interviews, medical records and clinician discussions

tasks.design: Keep eligibility assessment with the coordinator and responsible clinicians. {DOCS} holds protocol criteria and {OTHER} clinical records supply source evidence; no automated inclusion or exclusion is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical evidence may be incomplete or need interpretation against the protocol.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support the assessment; no new automation is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting records, uncertain dates and clinical exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Ask for the missing context and recognise when a clinician must decide.
tasks.altitude: Eligibility assessment and investigator decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Castor Catalyst proposes source-document values for human approval; this does not establish automatic clinical eligibility assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is eligibility assessment and recommendation, excluding final investigator enrolment and clinical diagnosis. {OTHER} means clinical records system.

The investigator supplies current eligibility criteria before assessment. Subjects produce screening answers during s1; clinicians supply clarifications during discussion before the assessment concludes. The coordinator captures criterion, source, value/date, interpretation and uncertainty within its full time; no free structured eligible-subject flag is assumed.
Missing or conflicting evidence returns to manual source review and clinician clarification. Test native record access before custom tooling; none is added.
Incremental upkeep is zero because the existing assessment process is unchanged; clinician decision work is unchanged.
research_questions: Is repeated factual extraction separable from clinical interpretation in observed cases?

already_counted.description: Screening, source review and eligibility interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0, net=0. Complete records and ambiguous clinical histories both retain source review and eligibility assessment time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify study documentation requirements, source versions and approved clinical interpretations
Copy verified study fields and assemble documentation tables
Prepare study-related narrative documentation without adding unsupported clinical conclusions

loop.purpose: Draft narrative from verified study facts
loop.input: Verified source brief, prefilled tables and approved document structure
loop.output: Draft narrative with source references and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Coordinator checks event chronology, procedure meaning, attribution and uncertainty against original records; clinical assessments must match the clinician's documented judgement
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; uncertain clinical meaning returns to manual drafting and investigator clarification
loop.why_not_simpler: Narrative varies by document and event; copying fields alone cannot express it

steps.what: Check the final study document and accept it for investigator review

tasks.design: Configure {DOCS} templates to reuse verified study fields, then draft narrative within a bounded loop. The coordinator checks the final contribution before investigator review; clinical judgement and external submission stay with their existing owners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated field copying and first-draft writing sit beside essential clinical verification.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and source-bounded drafting can support document preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Preserve clinical meaning, especially adverse-event chronology and attribution.
tasks.human_edge: Identify unsupported clinical claims and unresolved evidence gaps.
tasks.altitude: Less copying and first-draft writing, unchanged study accountability.

evidence.claim: Castor Catalyst proposes source-document values for human approval, supporting supervised field extraction rather than autonomous clinical decisions.
The digest's Novo Nordisk clinical study report case uses expert-approved text and human approval; its vendor-reported reduction is not applied to this whole task.
Model knowledge: local field-copy and narrative savings are unmeasured scenarios after source capture and review.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation of documentation contributions, excluding clinical assessment, investigator final approval, urgent safety actions and regulatory submission.

The coordinator produces study/subject references, protocol revision, document type, required fields, verified values, source versions, dates and unresolved issues in s1. Clinicians produce any required clinical interpretation before capture; manual extraction and clarification retain the full 35%. No free causality, seriousness or eligibility flag is assumed.
s2 copies only the s1 verified values; unknowns remain explicit. {OTHER} means clinical records system. Test native templates and exports before custom code.
Existing investigator and clinical review duties are unchanged and gain no claimed saving; approval of the completed package occurs after coordinator preparation under that existing process.
unknowns: Document mix, source access and existing prefilling
research_questions: Do source extraction and clinical meaning checks leave enough copying and drafting to justify upkeep?

incremental.description: Template, field mapping and exception review

approvals.approved_version: Exact document revision, fields, narrative, source links and unresolved issues checked before investigator handoff; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+17.5+20=72.5; gross=27.5, incremental=7, net=20.5. Range 0-8 allows existing prefilling or complex adverse-event interpretation to erase much of the copying and drafting gain; no clinical or external filing time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Configured scheduling and document support preserve clinical procedures, eligibility judgement and investigator authority.
reach: Explain study evidence, protocol windows and documentation limitations to scientific management.
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator with less repeated copying and slot searching while keeping subjects and clinical evidence central.
